crossRefs.note: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders…
While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of…
and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.
“You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”
Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?
Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!
Who has believed our message? To whom has Yahweh’s arm been revealed?
“Seventy weeks are decreed on your people and on your holy city, to finish disobedience, and to make an end of sins…
him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men…
“For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against…
to do whatever your hand and your council foreordained to happen.
What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”
Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to…
You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.
Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers…
They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”
